---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a focused improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## User problem

What workflow is difficult or impossible today?

## Desired outcome

Describe the result, not a preferred implementation.

## Privacy and attribution impact

Could this expose repository identity, dates, prompts, messages, or other
private data? Would it change explicit-evidence attribution, unknown/human
separation, aggregation units, the ACE schema, or the CLI contract?

## Alternatives

What existing command or external tool did you try?
